axes_source: Read from data/brands/voltagent.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #00D992 and the canvas #101010; contrast from the ink #F2F2F2 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #00D992; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 4, 6, 8px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #00D992 reaches 10.28:1 on the canvas #101010, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
